title: Contact and Border
author: Jonah Nakamura
blurb: Isandro Okafor, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
